description: ALABAMA HOUSE APPROVES RECORD $10.4 BILLION ETF BUDGET • The Alabama House approved on Tuesday a record $10.4 billion Education Trust Fund budget for Fiscal Year 2027 that allocates funding for the state’s K-12 public schools, community colleges, and four-year universities. • Sponsored
